title: ICE Agent Draws Loaded Gun on U.S. Citizen Carolina Molina in Falls Church, Virginia
excerpt: A masked ICE agent drew and pointed a loaded handgun at Carolina Molina, a licensed U.S. citizen counselor, through her car window during an enforcement operation in Falls Church, Virginia. Molina's dashcam footage contradicted DHS's claim that she had endangered agents.
content:
On August 10, 2026, during an immigration enforcement operation in the Bailey's Crossroads neighborhood of Falls Church, Virginia, a masked ICE agent drew a loaded handgun and pointed it directly at Carolina Molina, a U.S. citizen and licensed professional counselor, through the open window of her car.

DHS described Molina as an "anti-ICE agitator" and alleged she had tried to hit agents with her vehicle. However, dashcam footage released by Molina contradicted that account, showing she was never in close proximity to the agents or their vehicles prior to being approached at gunpoint.

  • Molina stated she was in the parking lot handing out business cards to immigration attorneys to offer counseling services when she encountered the agents.
  • Video showed a masked agent wearing a vest labeled "POLICE" standing at her car window with a gun drawn, arguing with Molina.
  • The incident was captured on both Molina's cellphone and her dashcam.
  • On August 19, House Judiciary Ranking Member Jamie Raskin, House Oversight Ranking Member Robert Garcia, House Homeland Security Ranking Member Bennie Thompson, and three Northern Virginia representatives opened a formal investigation, requesting an immediate FBI investigation and DOJ Civil Rights Division review.
  • Lawmakers demanded the involved agents be placed on administrative leave pending the investigation's conclusion.

The Falls Church encounter followed a string of high-profile vehicle stops during federal immigration enforcement operations that drew national scrutiny throughout 2026.
source: Washington Post / NBC Washington / House Judiciary Committee Democrats
